description.text: Grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Instant Cast 2], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Biggs], [Knight of the Round Damage Tracker] and [Knight of the Round Level]

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Biggs
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Knight of the Round (0~2), removed after using Knight of the Round two times

description.name: Knight of the Round Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Knight of the Round level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Biggs]

description.name: Knight of the Round Level
description.text: Keeps track of Knight of the Round level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Biggs]
